title: Conversational brain AI for adaptive epilepsy care
script:
Nature published a study on a new conversational AI built for epilepsy care.
Patients used a phone app to exchange over one thousand three hundred text messages with the system.
The conversational platform helps fine tune wearable seizure detectors using patient feedback.
Clinicians can converse with the chat interface to review automated seizure assessments and add notations.
Would you use a chat app to track your health symptoms?
